descriptions.value: The GeoDirectory  WordPress plugin before 2.8.196 does not properly sanitise or escape a post badge click-through link value before outputting it in an anchor element on a listing, allowing users with the Contributor role and above to perform Stored Cross-Site Scripting attacks against higher-privileged users who view the listing, including an administrator reviewing moderated content.

assertions.title: GeoDirectory < 2.8.196 - Contributor+ Stored XSS via gd_post_badge 'link' Attribute

descriptions.description: CWE-79 Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

title: GeoDirectory < 2.8.196 - Contributor+ Stored XSS via gd_post_badge 'link' Attribute

descriptions.value: Improper neutralization of special elements used in a command ('command injection') in Windows Admin Center allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

descriptions.description: CWE-77: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')

assertions.title: Windows Admin Center (WAC) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

references.name: Windows Admin Center (WAC) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

title: Windows Admin Center (WAC) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

descriptions.value: Operation on a resource after expiration or release in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) allows an unauthorized attacker to disclose information over a network.
